_readme: Every external source this project has taken content from, in one place.
This is an INDEX, not a copy. The detail for each family stays in the
registry that importer already owns -- importers/sources.json,
tools/darshanas/darshana_sources.json, tools/DvaitaVedanta/Itara/DasaSahitya/dasa_sources.json,
tools/dvaitavedanta/dv_sources.json, tools/sayana_smriti/sources.json,
tools/kavya/config/sources.json, dge/kosha_toolkit/LICENSING.md -- and
`config` below points at it. Copying those entries here would guarantee the
two drift, and a source registry that lies is worse than none.
WHAT EACH FIELD IS FOR
probe    how to tell, cheaply, whether the source has changed since we
last looked. tools/check_sources.py implements each kind.
feeds    what in dge/data (or which published branch) came from it.
importer the workflow that re-imports it. Blank means no importer exists
yet and a change is a note for a human, not a job to run.
rights   the licence position in one line. The long form lives in the
owning config or in LICENSING.md.
A source with `imported: false` is one we have read, cited or evaluated but
never ingested. It is here so that the question 'where did this come from,
and did we check it?' has an answer for every site the project has touched.
`watch_only: true` marks a site we have not imported from but want to hear about (sarvamulavani.com). The admin page's syncer card for it can only Check, never Import.

sources.title: GRETIL — Göttingen Register of Electronic Texts in Indian Languages
sources.rights: Per-file, non-commercial.
sources.cadence: quarterly is plenty; GRETIL grows slowly

sources.title: sanskritsahitya-com/data (the ashtadhyayi.com team)
feeds: kavya_alankara (tier A: mula, Mallinatha, padaccheda, anvaya, translations)
sources.rights: No LICENSE file. Curator permission for educational/non-commercial use; re-confirm before a public launch.
sources.cadence: fortnightly — this is the richest kavya source and it does move

sources.title: ambuda.org — proofed TEI library
feeds: kavya_alankara (tier C: Amarusataka, Dutavakya, Urubhanga, Bhartrhari's three satakas)
sources.rights: CC0/CC-BY per text; check each.
sources.cadence: fortnightly; the export is dated and one file

sources.title: sa.wikisource.org
feeds: kavya_alankara (tier D: the dramas, Naishadhiya, Kadambari, Harshacarita, Kavyaprakasha)
sources.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribution required.
sources.cadence: fortnightly; a wiki changes under you without telling you

sources.title: dvaitavedanta.in (DVSRF)

probe.note: No sitemap (theirs is a soft 404) and the front page is a script-driven shell, so the fingerprint is the union of links found at one seed page per section.

feeds: dvaitavedanta (699 granthas, 20,210 units — the largest single import)
sources.rights: No explicit licence. Absence of a licence is not permission — see the config's own header.

sources.title: madhwafestivals.com
sources.rights: Public devotional archive; non-commercial reproduction.
sources.cadence: fortnightly — a blog, so new posts are exactly what we want to catch

sources.title: dasasahitya.net
sources.rights: Public Haridasa lyrics site; non-commercial.

sources.title: meerasubbarao.wordpress.com
sources.rights: Public devotional lyrics blog; non-commercial.

sources.title: SanskritDocuments.org
sources.rights: Free for personal/educational use; attribution.

sources.title: IndoWordNet (CFILT, IIT Bombay) via the pyiwn dump
sources.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 per the pyiwn distribution; IndoWordNet's own pages say research use. OPEN QUESTION.
sources.cadence: yearly; the dump is from 2019 and has not moved

sources.title: indic-dict StarDict repositories (the kosha corpus)
sources.importer: (the Build Kosha corpus Action in bhumandala-kosha-data)
sources.rights: Cologne re-distributions CC-BY-SA 4.0; the rest carry no explicit licence and ship with an 'Unclear' badge.

sources.title: archive.org

probe.note: Per-item; probe the item's metadata endpoint when an item id is known.

sources.rights: Per item.

sources.title: sites.utexas.edu Sanskrit resources (the Sayana Google-Doc hub)
sources.rights: Per document.

sources.title: OPenn — University of Pennsylvania Kislak Center
sources.rights: Public domain images.
sources.cadence: on demand — manuscript images, evaluated, not ingested

sources.title: wisdomlib.org
sources.rights: Site terms restrict reuse; consulted for reference only.

sources.title: sacred-texts.com
sources.rights: Public-domain Ganguli translation; imported by importers/mahabharata_ganguli.py.

sources.title: valmikiramayan.net
sources.rights: No explicit licence; consulted for verification.

sources.title: sarvamulavani.com — Sarvamūla reader (SQLite-backed single page)

probe.note: The reader loads one sarvamula.db from that host after asking version.json which revision is current (2026-08-18a on 9 Sep 2026). Every route on the site itself returns the same app shell, so the version stamp is the only honest signal.

sources.rights: Not yet ingested; no licence statement found on the site. A change here is a note for the lead, not a job.

sources.title: setutila.in — SetuTila Sarvamūla edition (WordPress)

probe.note: Total published posts plus the newest modified_gmt, the same field tools/setutila/import_setutila.py's delta sync keys on.

sources.rights: Case-by-case permission recorded by the lead; all 47 leaves flagged restricted.

sources.title: anandamakaranda.in — Ānandamakaranda wiki (Sarvamūla source)

probe.note: A MediaWiki; the newest main-namespace revision id plus the wiki's page count.

feeds: darshana/vedanta/dvaita/Anandamakaranda (47 works with wiki provenance; merged one-to-one or snapshotted by sync-anandamakaranda.yml)
sources.rights: No licence statement; used under the lead's case-by-case authorisation. Existing works are synced; new works are reported, never imported blind.

sources.title: srivaishnavan.com — Śrī Rāmānuja Meghamālā (JIR Foundation)

probe.note: The Meghamālā is one long WordPress page; its modified_gmt moves when the page is edited.

sources.rights: Public site; case-by-case permission recorded 2 Sep 2026. Synced by grantha when posts change (sync-meghamala.yml).

sources.title: advaitasharada.sringeri.net — Sringeri Advaita Śāradā critical edition

probe.note: A static (Astro) site with no sitemap: the fingerprint is the set of /read/<work> links on the home page plus the build-hashed asset names, which change on every deploy.

sources.rights: Case-by-case permission (2 Sep 2026); licensed corpus — must not be indexed publicly (docs/SEO_ARCHITECTURE.md). Refreshed by sync-advaitasharada.yml; never widened.

sources.title: ashtadhyayi.com — sūtra, vṛtti and commentary data (github ashtadhyayi-com/data)

probe.note: The site is built from this public repository; its latest commit is the change signal.

sources.rights: Curator's e-mail permission held by the lead; no LICENSE file on the repo. Re-imported by sync-ashtadhyayi.yml when the repository moves.
